title: 第11章 红霞剑第12章 阴谋
content_zh:
就目前来看，这所谓半个“旅行商人”
的箓位给我带来的好处有三点。
第一，也是最主要的，让我获得了“大日星槎”
的部分权限，可以使用其中的一些功能。
第二，让我的灵魂强度有了些许提升，达到了“入静”
的标准。
第三，就是刚刚发现的，可以让我在遇到紧急情况时，进入一种特殊的“冷静”
状态，屏蔽掉部分恐惧，以便更好的计算利益得失……当然，这种计算也是基于我自身水平的，并不会提升，也不是绝对正确。
另外，兴奋、激动等情绪却进行了保留……这大概是因为人在兴奋时会分泌肾上腺素，让思维更加敏捷，有助于计算得失，做出更有利于自己的决定。
思绪电转间，赵晨跟着师傅不断后退，很快就退到了街角。
他没有试图趁着黄显钧馆主阻击怪物时自己逃走，毕竟对方明显是冲着他来的，一旦在离开师傅身边后遭到攻击，师傅很可能救援不及。
砰！
砰！
又是两声枪响，黄显钧再次命中了怪物的两个头颅，将其打得血肉模糊，惨叫不已……然而，这却并不能阻挡怪物前进的脚步——它借助跳跃，已然立到了武馆位于街角的那处高墙上。
此时，赵晨二人距离怪物不过十几步，对方身上那浓重的血腥气味呼吸可闻，似乎对方只要一次扑击，就能让师徒二人毙命于此。
但黄显钧却并不慌张，他在打出最后一发子弹后，伸手抓住徒弟的胳膊，然后身体猛地一窜，带着他撞入了临街一个店铺的窗户内。
与此同时，街角的另一侧，一排士兵已经端起长火铳，瞄准了立在墙壁上的那头豺狼般的怪物。
“射击！”
随着小队队长挥动手中的令旗，十几杆火铳同时开火，瞬间就将怪物身上打出了一个个血洞。
怪物吃痛之下，终于从愤怒中稍稍清醒了一点，想要先逃离这里，但却骇然发现自己竟不知不觉间被某种力量束缚住，难以动弹分毫。

一时间，这头庞大而恐惧的怪物就仿佛变成了靶子，任由士兵们将子弹倾泻在其身上。
啪！
啪！
啪……
当一阵阵炒豆子般的密集声响到了第四轮时，怪物的惨叫声、咆哮声尽皆消失不见。
赵晨这时候也从师傅身后探出头，顺着被撞破的窗户向武馆的墙壁上望去，只见那怪物的模样凄惨无比，浑身上下到处都是血肉模糊的弹孔不说，就连四肢都已经被打断，两个头颅更是被完全撕碎，半点不剩。
它此刻正如同一个烤焦的肉块一般团在墙上，一动都不动，好似已经死了。
见此情景，小队长也抬起了令旗，让士兵们停下了射击。
而就在所有人都以为事情已经结束时，那怪物背脊上的双角却再次立起，压榨所剩不多的生命，让黑色光芒迅速凝聚，化作了一柄肉眼可见的漆黑刀刃，向着躲在路边店铺内的赵晨和黄显钧极速斩来。
这一道刀刃速度极快，不会输给子弹太多，且范围很大，难以躲避。
“哎！”
黄显钧叹息一声，他到底不忍心自家弟子死于自己面前，尤其是在自己还有余力的情况下，于是就要强行催动本命法术，以“金镖”
挡住漆黑刀刃。
可就在这时候，一道火红色的剑光却后发先至，只一击就将那道漆黑刀刃斩碎，继而在空中绕了个圈，然后径直插进了怪物两只长角中间的位置。
下一刻，火光乍现，并迅速吞噬了怪物的整个躯体，仅仅十几秒时间，院墙上便只留下了一只足足有网球大小的眼珠，以及眼珠下尚有余温的灰烬。
而那道红色剑光卷起眼珠就再次升空，最后落到一位有着双十年华的女子手中，化成了一柄看似极为普通的长剑。
那女子面容清丽、风姿绰约，穿着一身红色公服，看起来英姿飒爽，又不失女性的魅力。
见到这女子现身彻底解决了怪物，一位身穿紫袍，身材魁梧的中年男子从火铳队后面分众而出，走到近前拱手道：
“原来是‘伏魔使’燕大人驾临，李某有失远迎……多亏了您出手，我那外孙才能得以保全。”
燕姓女子却摆摆手，微笑说道：“李镇守不必客气，斩妖除魔本就是我们‘道官’分内的事……另外，我和秀凌是好友，也是您的晚辈，您直接叫我红霞就好。”
content_en:
As of now, this so-called half "traveling merchant"
There are three benefits that my position has brought to me.
First and most importantly, it allowed me to obtain the "Great Sun Star"
Some permissions can be used to use some of these functions.
Second, it has slightly improved the strength of my soul and reached "quietness"
standards.
Third, I just discovered that it allows me to enter a special "calm" state when encountering an emergency.
state, shielding part of the fear, so as to better calculate the gains and losses... Of course, this calculation is also based on my own level, and will not improve, nor is it absolutely correct.
In addition, emotions such as excitement and excitement are retained... This is probably because people secrete adrenaline when they are excited, which makes their thinking more agile, helps them calculate gains and losses, and make decisions that are more beneficial to them.
As his thoughts were spinning, Zhao Chen followed his master and kept retreating, and soon retreated to the corner of the street.
He did not try to escape while the master of the hall, Huang Xianjun, was blocking the monster. After all, the opponent was obviously coming for him. Once he was attacked after leaving the master's side, the master would probably not be able to rescue him in time.
Bang!
Bang!
There were two more gunshots, and Huang Xianjun hit the monster's two heads again, beating it to a bloody pulp and screaming... However, this could not stop the monster from moving forward - with the help of a jump, it had already stood on the high wall of the martial arts school at the corner of the street.
At this time, Zhao Chen and Zhao Chen were only a dozen steps away from the monster, and the strong smell of blood on the opponent's body could be heard. It seemed that the opponent could kill the master and the disciple with just one attack.
But Huang Xianjun did not panic. After firing the last bullet, he reached out and grabbed his apprentice's arm, and then his body suddenly jumped, leading him into the window of a shop facing the street.
At the same time, on the other side of the street corner, a row of soldiers had already picked up long blazing guns and aimed at the jackal-like monster standing on the wall.
"Shoot!"
As the team leader waved the command flag in his hand, more than a dozen fire cannons opened fire at the same time, instantly punching bloody holes in the monster's body.
After suffering from pain, the monster finally woke up a little from its anger and wanted to escape from here first, but was shocked to find that it was unknowingly restrained by some kind of force, making it difficult to move at all.
For a moment, this huge and terrifying monster seemed to become a target, allowing the soldiers to pour bullets on it.
Snap!
Snap!
Snap...
When the dense sounds like fried beans reached the fourth round, the monster's screams and roars all disappeared.
At this time, Zhao Chen also poked his head out from behind his master and looked at the wall of the martial arts hall along the broken window. He saw that the monster looked extremely miserable, with bloody bullet holes all over its body. Even its limbs had been broken, and its two heads had been completely torn into pieces, with no trace left.
It was just like a piece of burnt meat massed on the wall, motionless, as if it was dead.
Seeing this scene, the squad leader also raised the command flag and asked the soldiers to stop shooting.
And just when everyone thought the matter was over, the two horns on the monster's back stood up again, squeezing out the little life left, causing the black light to quickly condense, turning into a dark blade visible to the naked eye, and slashing at Zhao Chen and Huang Xianjun who were hiding in the roadside shop at high speed.
This blade is extremely fast and will not lose too much to bullets. It has a large range and is difficult to dodge.
"Hey!"
Huang Xianjun sighed. He couldn't bear the death of his disciple in front of him, especially when he still had some strength left, so he had to forcefully activate his natal magic and use the "Golden Dart"
Block the pitch black blade.
But at this moment, a fiery red sword light arrived first and chopped the pitch-black blade into pieces with just one blow. Then it circled in the air and then inserted directly into the middle of the monster's two long horns.location.
The next moment, the fire suddenly appeared and quickly devoured the monster's entire body. In just ten seconds, only an eyeball the size of a tennis ball was left on the wall of the courtyard, and ashes still warm under the eyeball.
The red sword light rolled up its eyes and rose into the sky again. Finally, it fell into the hands of a woman with twenty years of beauty, and turned into a seemingly ordinary long sword.
The woman has a beautiful face and graceful appearance. She is wearing a red official uniform and looks heroic without losing her feminine charm.
Seeing that the woman appeared and completely eliminated the monster, a burly middle-aged man wearing a purple robe came out from behind the gun team, walked up to him and said:
"It turns out that Mr. Yan, the 'Devil-Suppressing Envoy', is here, and Li is not far away to welcome him... Thanks to your intervention, my grandson can be saved."
The woman surnamed Yan waved her hand and said with a smile: "Li Zhengshou, you don't have to be polite. Killing demons and slaying demons is our job as 'Taoist officials'... In addition, Xiuling and I are good friends and are also your juniors. You can just call me Hongxia."
